name: SCALINQ
description: SCALINQ is a Swedish quantum hardware company and spin-off from Chalmers University of Technology in Gothenburg. The company develops cost-efficient, energy-efficient, high-density cryogenic-grade hardware for superconducting and spin-qubit quantum processors. Its patent-pending LINQER product family provides complete packaging solutions and sample holders with 16 to 300 connectors for quantum computing systems.
